name: Wisconsin

context: WI 340: Wisconsin has two cover crop planting zones, north and south, set by frost dates and growing season (Table 3).
cover_rules: WI 340: Seed with at least 85% Pure Live Seed (PLS); below that, adjust the rate with the PLS equation.
WI 340: Planting may run up to seven days past the Table 3 dates with documented favorable weather and soil conditions.
residue: WI 329: Keep a crop interval STIR value of 20 or less, and distribute residue uniformly over the field.
WI 329: Keep at least 60 percent residue cover lying flat when the soil is not covered by a living plant canopy.
seeding: WI 340: Plant the cover crop as early as possible and terminate as late as practical to protect soil in critical erosion periods.

coverPlant.text: WI 340: Winter rye: North 7/15-10/25, South 7/15-11/1; oats: North 4/15-9/1, South 4/15-9/15.

seedWin.text: WI 340: Winter rye is seeded 7/15-10/25 in the north and 7/15-11/1 in the south.
